extract_probe.label: english-g8-families
extract_probe.extract_md:
This lesson teaches students about family members, family trees, adverbs of manner, adverbs of degree, and the experience of growing up in a large family.

## Concepts & terms
- Adverbs of manner — words that describe how we do things
- Adverbs of degree — words that modify adjectives and adverbs to show intensity or degree (e.g., nearly, probably, quite, really, certainly)
- Family tree — a diagram showing the relationships between people in a family over several generations

## Rules & theorems
- Adverbs of manner describe how actions are performed.
- Many adverbs of manner are formed by adding -ly to the adjective.
- For adjectives ending in -l, we double the l and add -y in the adverb form (e.g., beautifully).
- For adjectives ending in a consonant + -y, we remove the -y and add -ily (e.g., easily).
- Irregular adverb forms include good turning to well, fast staying fast, and hard staying hard.

## Worked-example types
- Complete a family tree based on a listening description
- Describe family members using adjectives of physical appearance and personality
- Form adverbs of manner from given adjectives and use them in sentences
- Complete advice sentences by changing adjectives into adverbs where necessary
- Answer reading comprehension questions about a personal text on growing up in a big family
- Match adverbs of degree to their correct meanings
- Write and share true and false sentences about one's family using adverbs of degree
- Write a description of one's own family using correct grammar and vocabulary

## Key facts
- Ella Blackstone is the oldest of eight children and describes what it is like to grow up in a big family.
- Sharing bedrooms, toys, and parents' time is common in large families, and moving quickly is necessary.
- Families often have rich and interesting stories in their past, and knowing birth dates of family members is important for tracing family history.

- I am the oldest of eight children.

“Alpomish” dostoni o‘zbek xalq og‘zaki ijodining eng yuksak va mukammal namunalaridan biri bo‘lib, unda xalqimizning iymon-e’tiqod, or-nomus, do‘stlik va vatanparvarlik kabi ezgu fazilatlari haqqoniy hamda ta’sirchan aks ettirilgan.

## Key facts
- «Alpomish» dostonining o‘nlab nusxalari mavjud bo‘lib, ular orasida buyuk baxshisi Fozil Yo‘ldosh o‘g‘li ijro etgan nusxa voqealarning qiziqarliligi va ta’sirchanligi bilan eng yuksak turadi.
- Fozil Yo‘ldosh o‘g‘li 1872-yilda Jizzax viloyatining Baxmal tumaniga qarashli Loyqa qishlog‘ida tug‘ilgan.
- 1999-yilda «Alpomish» dostoni yaratilganining ming yilligi O‘zbekistonda keng bayram qilindi.
- Doston boshida Dobonbiydan Alpinbiy, undan Boybo‘ri va Boysari tug‘ilganligi, ularning farzandsiz o‘tishi va keyinchalik Shohimardon pir ravzasini tunab farzand tilagani hikoya qilinadi.
- Shohimardon pir Boybo‘rining o‘g‘liga Hakimbek (Alpomish), qiziga Qaldirg‘ochoyim, Boysarining qiziga Oybarchin deb ot qo‘yib, Hakimbek bilan Oybarchinni beshikkerti qiladi.
- Yetti yoshida o‘n to‘rt botmon bronza yoyni tortgan Hakimbek alp deb tan olinib, Alpomish otini ko‘tardi.
- Boybo‘rining zakot talab qilishi natijasida Boysari o‘n ming uyli qo‘ng‘irot elini boshlab Qalmoq yurtiga (Kashal eliga) ko‘chib ketadi.
- Qalmoqda Oybarchin bo‘y yetgach, Surxayil kampirning o‘g‘illari — to‘qson qalmoq alpi unga uylanish uchun og‘iz soladi, ammo Barchin ularni yengib, olti oy muhlat so‘rab Alpomishga xabar yuboradi.
- Alpomish Qultoydan dastlab qiyinchilik ko‘rsa-da, Chibar (Boychibor) otni minib, pirlar ko‘magida Qalmoq yurtiga yo‘l oladi.
- Yo‘lda Qorajon bilan tanishib do‘stlashadi, Qorajon musulmon bo‘lib Alpomishga do‘st bo‘ladi.
- Qalmoq alplari poygada yutolmasligini bilib, Qorajonni toshga bog‘lab, Boychiborning tuyog‘iga gulmixlar qoqib nomardlik qiladilar, biroq Rajabxo‘ja pirning madadi bilan ular ozod bo‘ladilar.
- Alpomish yoy tortish, miltiq otish va kurash shartlarida to‘qson alpni va bosh polvon Ko‘kaldoshni yengib, Oybarchinga uylanadi va eliga qaytadi.

## Source sentences & passages
- «Ey, Boy bo‘ri bilan Boysari! Bu to‘y o‘g‘illining o‘g‘lidan qaytadi, qizlining qizidan qaytadi, sеning nimangdan qaytadi?! O‘zing o‘lsang, molingga har mеrosxo‘r chiqadi, og‘ziga odam kirib kеtadi».
- «Oh urganda ko‘zdan oqar sеlob yosh, Maslahat bеr, o‘n ming uyli qarindosh, Qo‘ng‘irot eldan molga zakot kеlibdi, Maslahat bеr, o‘n ming uyli qarindosh!»
- «Eshitgin, qalmoqlar, aytgan tilimnan, Mеni olar kеlmas sеning qo‘lingnan. Badbaxt qalmoq, qolma kеlgan yo‘lingnan, Mеni olmoqqa hadding bormi, qalmoqlar».
- «Ot chopsa, gumburlar tog‘ning darasi, Botirni ingratar nayza yarasi. Kеlgan bo‘lsa qo‘ng‘irot elning to‘rasi, Qirq kunlik yo‘l Boboxonning orasi».
- «Aka, sеnga aytadigan arzim bor, Talash bo‘pti biyning qizi — zulfakdor... Mard yigitning yori talash bo‘lami, Er yigitning yorin qalmoq olami?»
- «Bobongning so‘zini hazil bilasan, Sеn g‘arbachcha, nеga aynalib kеlasan. Sеn enag‘ar, bildim tayin o‘lasan, Nimishing bor, tag‘i nеga kеlasan?»
- «Qurruyo-qur, hayt-a, to‘ramning oti, Oq to‘shim — yayloving, sochim shibirtki. Kuyganimdan gapni gapga ulayin, To o‘lgancha sayising bo‘p yurayin».
- «Har kim o‘z eliga bеkmi, to‘rami, O‘zi o‘lmay, kishi yorin bеrami? Buncha so‘zni lof urmagin, sеn qalmoq, Kеl endi, maydonda turgin, ey ahmoq».
- «Sayding qo‘yaber, sayyod, sayyora ekan mendek, Ol domini bo‘ynidin, bechora ekan mendek, O‘z yorini topmasdan ovora ekan mendek, Iqboli nigun, baxti ham qora ekan mendek...»
- «Ilohi, har kuning navro‘z bo‘lsun, Hamisha tole’ying feruz bo‘lsun. Bo‘lub ayyomi navro‘zing muborak, Zamiring inbisotanduz bo‘lsun».
